title: TreasuryAsset
description: Individual treasury asset record for a given day — one row per (token, wallet, chain, block) combination.

chain.description: EVM chain on which the asset is held.

wallet.description: Treasury wallet or contract address holding the asset.

price.description: Token price in USD at the snapshot block.

balance.description: Token balance at the snapshot block.

value.description: USD value of the balance at the snapshot block (price * balance).

block.description: Block number of the canonical daily snapshot.

isLiquid.description: Whether the asset is considered liquid for treasury liquid-backing calculations.
